rules.statement: A lender is not under a duty to advise a borrower on the viability of a transaction or to ensure that the borrower gets good title to the property.
rules.supporting_quote: This is one reason why a borrower is not entitled to rely on the fact that the lender has chosen to lend him the money as evidence, still less as advice, that the lender thinks that the purpose for which the borrower intends to use it is sound.
